M1 functionally complete (0010-0013 done) but stays in_progress -- one deliberately-deferred DoD box left (download queue/pause/cancel), see MILESTONES.md. M2 tasks 0014-0017 ALL done; M2 stays in_progress on its one DoD line -- a real tauri-driver E2E boot -- which is deferred to M6's e2e-suite work (the flow is wired end to end and fake/Vitest-tested, a real booted-emulator run is the honest gap from 0015/0016). Task 0017: src-tauri/src/commands/emulator.rs -- 6 tauri-specta commands (list_devices/list_images/list_emulators/create_emulator/launch_emulator/stop_emulator) + one EmulatorJob event (job://emulator, mirrors toolchain::BootstrapProgress). AndroidProvider built per-command (like toolchain.rs builds its ports per-call) -- documented consequence: the child-handle map from 0016 doesn't persist, so stop uses the graceful adb emu kill path without a held handle (fine for M2, shared/managed provider is M3). list_devices/list_images done in the SHELL not on the Provider trait (trait sigs can't take manifest bytes/Downloader, and reqwest in emu-android would break 'network behind a port') -- devices::parse_from_jar (new pure fn + zip dep on emu-android) on the installed sdklib jar bytes read from disk, sysimg::parse on the 6 sys-img2-3.xml manifests fetched concurrently via futures_util::try_join_all -- exactly the toolchain::resolve_catalog pattern. New AndroidProvider pub surface: sdk_root (pub), is_image_installed(coord), tracked_states()->Vec<TrackedEmulator> (registry rows + live RunState probed from adb -- lightweight read-only, NOT reconcile()). Registry::list_emulators() added on the emu-core side. Create.tsx rewritten as a 4-step wizard (device search/pick -> image pick with installed/size -> hardware name+RAM+storage -> review -> Create / Create & launch, live job-log panel via useEmulatorJob). Dashboard.tsx rewritten -> useEmulators() list (4s poll) with per-row Launch/Stop. ipc.ts: useDevices/useImages/useEmulators/useCreateEmulator/useLaunchEmulator/useStopEmulator/useEmulatorJob. Wizard scope trims (documented in 0017's Notes + MILESTONES.md): hardware form is name/RAM/storage only (rest default), inline image download folded into 'Create' (runs ensure_image first), 'Save as profile' is M4, uptime needs the launch-timestamp M3 schema, ensure_image progress is a coarse log line not sdkmanager's byte bar. specta quirk: f32 exports as 'number | null', frontend tolerates it. 22 web tests (+9: Create.test.tsx new, Dashboard.test.tsx rewritten), 3 new Rust unit tests -- 114 rust tests total. just validate green (bindings.ts diff is the normal pre-commit regen state -- lefthook stages it). Task 0015: AndroidProvider is emu-android's first real Provider impl; ensure_image delegates to a real sdkmanager invocation (design change made mid-task after a real 720MB system-image install proved sdkmanager already fetches/verifies/unpacks correctly -- no Downloader/zip code), create() drives a real avdmanager create avd -n/-k/-d with all 3 real failure texts classified; EmulatorId::generate() (ulid dep) + Registry::insert_emulator/get_emulator added. Task 0016: launch() spawns 'emulator @<avd>' (+ -no-window/-wipe-data/-no-snapshot-load/-gpu <mode> from LaunchOpts + extra_args -- flags cited from the official emulator-commandline docs, not invented), streams output lines onto the JobHandle, polls 'adb -s <serial> shell getprop sys.boot_completed' until '1' with a wall-clock DEFAULT_BOOT_TIMEOUT (300s, overridable via with_boot_timeout), and fast-fails if the emulator process exits (stream EOF) before boot. The spawned child is HELD in AndroidProvider.running (EmulatorId -> Arc<AsyncMutex<Box<dyn ChildProcess>>>) rather than dropped -- that's what lets stop() reap it ('never orphans') and keeps its stdout drained. stop() does graceful 'adb -s <serial> emu kill' (serial found by matching the registry avd_name against each 'adb -s <s> emu avd name'), waits up to DEFAULT_STOP_TIMEOUT (15s, overridable), then force-kills the held child; idempotent when nothing's running, NotFound for an unknown id. grpc_port left None (M3 detail-panel work). Testing-infra addition in emu-core: FakeProcessRunner::on_spawn_lingering + a FakeChild 'lingering' flag (next_line never resolves after scripted lines, until kill) so the pure timeout path -- stream open, boot never completes -- is testable; a general fake improvement, not a one-off. emu-android tokio deps gained 'time'+'sync' features (no 'rt' -- runs on the caller's runtime). 8 new emu-android tests (launch happy/streams/exits-before-boot/timeout, stop emu-kill/idempotent/unknown-id/force-kill) -- 109 rust tests total in just validate, green. No IPC surface touched, bindings.ts regenerated as a no-op diff. Honest gap (noted in 0016's Notes): no unit test drives a real emulator/adb -- argv/poll-loop/timeout/fallbacks are fake-covered, end-to-end boot is M2's tauri-driver E2E (task 0017) or a future --ignored test; Unix zombie-reap on app-kill is M3 kill-safety. Deferred, unchanged: .sqlx/ offline cache + query! macros (M3); gitleaks/lychee/typos CI installers (just setup); e2e suite; branch protection (human); Downloader pause/resume/cancel/queueing. M3 scoped into four tasks 0018-0021 (same granularity as M1/M2): 0018 full registry schema (migrations/0002_registry_m3.sql) + typed EmulatorRow Registry API; 0019 AndroidProvider::reconcile + delete + kill-safety + the M3 DoD property test; 0020 shared managed provider (tauri::State, so the spawned-child map persists -> real force-kill + app-exit reap) + startup reconcile + rename/edit-hardware/delete/wipe/reconcile_now/emulator_detail commands; 0021 /emulator/:id detail panel + per-emulator log console (launch tees its stream to <data_dir>/logs/<avd>.log). Task 0018 DONE (review): migrations/0002_registry_m3.sql ALTER TABLEs emulators up to the full tracked record + adds host_snapshots; compound values (Hardware, EmulatorSource, tags) are single JSON text columns (hardware_json/source_json/tags_json) NOT one column per field -- so a struct change needs no migration; hardware_json's migration default is Hardware::default() serialized verbatim, a test guards the round trip. New crates/emu-core/src/registry/row.rs: EmulatorRow (typed: Option<ImageCoord>, Hardware, EmulatorSource, RunState, Vec<String> tags, OffsetDateTime x3, Option<u16> grpc_port, Option<u32> pid) + HostSnapshotRow, both mapped from SqliteRow via manual try_get (no FromRow derive). Registry API is now TYPED: upsert_emulator(&EmulatorRow) (INSERT..ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE, preserves created_at), get_row, list_rows, set_run_fields, rename, set_hardware, delete_row->bool, insert_host_snapshot, latest_host_snapshot.
